what: Contract data the geometry doesn't carry (br-bwju.5, the bike part set of jj.vehicle.v1): mass split, hinges, collider kinds, anchors and LOD budgets. Pivots come from the model (model.js pivots(), the bike kit's hinge lines); the bake joins the two into pig-catcher.asset.json. front (forks, beaked mudguard, number-plate shroud, light bar and spots) hangs about its rear top edge 0-25 degrees, back (rear mudguard, rack, rope and sack) about its front top edge, the rider pitches about the hip (R121: a crash throws the rider), wheels +-6 degrees camber. +X is the bike's left. No interior blocks: a bike has no bays behind its panels.

anchorNotes.cam_fp: The rider's eyes, behind the goggles.
anchorNotes.roof_number: On the rider's back (the khaki shirt), where the number reads from the chase camera and from above.
anchorNotes.lplate_front: On the number-plate shroud, under the light bar.
anchorNotes.lplate_rear: On the rear mudguard's tail, above the tail lamp.
